default/31746.htm.text: Fallen Unicorn: An equine female with shiny, white hair lies listlessly on the ground. A small, sharp ivory-colored horn protrudes from her forehead. This is a unicorn called Eva's Luck! The sight of her brings tears. A closer look is impossible due to an invisible force field around her.

Q00242_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul2/31746-0.text: Fallen Unicon: The Fallen Unicorn is surrounded by a strong force, making it impossible to get near it. The source of the force appears to be the four Cornerstones of Restraining laid down around the Fallen Unicorn.
Fallen Unicorn: The unicorn staggers to its feet. The force field must be gone.
